description: An interactive frontend-only birthday invitation website where visitors open an envelope and letter/card to reveal birthday details.

services.name: Invitation website
features: Optional RSVP/contact call-to-action without backend persistence

questions.question: Which language should the invitation website use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for maintainable interactive UI code.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Standard JavaScript with a simpler setup.

questions.rationale: TypeScript is recommended for a polished interactive frontend.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should power the invitation experience?

options.label: React
options.description: Component-based UI framework well suited to animation and stateful interactions.

options.label: Vue
options.description: Approachable component framework for interactive pages.

options.label: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript
options.description: Minimal dependency approach for a simple static invitation.

questions.question: Describe any additional invitation details, visual style, or interactions to include.
questions.recommendedChoice: Interactive envelope opening, birthday card reveal, responsive layout, accessibility, and reduced-motion support.
questions.answer: Interactive envelope opening, birthday card reveal, responsive layout, accessibility, and reduced-motion support.

options.label: No datastore required
